The '''slothar''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument that could be played by wagging it. Prior to his [[Death/Legends|death]]<ref name="SWI 67" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," including the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the [[Letaki]] [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], a [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who led a [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers|Jizz-Wailers]] band, could wag a slothar better than anyone.<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
The slothar was introduced in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article written by [[Rich Handley]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="SWI 67" /> which was published on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
